family.description: Mitoguardin (Miga) was first identified in flies as a mitochondrial outer-membrane protein that promotes mitochondrial fusion. Later, the mammalian Miga homologues, Miga1 and Miga2, were identified. They are found to promote mitochondrial fusion by regulating mitochondrial phospholipid metabolism via MitoPLD [[cite:PUB00077967],[cite:PUB00077968]].
family.name: Mitoguardin
